name: GhostCommandPaletteContent
description: Dialog surface (role="dialog") composing the shared dialog focus scope, scroll lock, inert background, and dismissal. Focuses the command input on open by default and hosts the polite live region. Unmounted while closed. After logical close it stays mounted with data-state="closed", inert, and pointer-events: none only while its own CSS exit transition or animation runs (useGhostPresence), then unmounts; focus, dismissal, scroll lock, and background inert release immediately.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag name or component rendered for the dialog surface.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description: Dismisses the palette on outside pointerdown, including the overlay.

props.name: focusReady
props.description: Gates the first focus-scope activation of each opening.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Resolves the element focused on open; defaults to the command input.

props.name: portal
props.description: Teleport content through `GhostPortal` when `true`, or render inline when `false`.

props.name: portalTo
props.description: Teleport target passed to `GhostPortal` when `portal` is `true`.

props.name: returnFocus
props.description: Resolves the element focused on close; invalid or `null` keeps the saved opener.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Mounted palette surface element while open or exiting; null once unmounted.

parts.name: content
parts.description: Surface with class ghost-command-palette-content and data-part="content".

parts.name: announcer
parts.description: Visually hidden polite live region for loading, empty, and result-count messages.

states.name: closed
states.description: Applied on data-state while the surface plays its exit motion after logical close; the surface is also inert with inline pointer-events: none until it unmounts.

keyboard.Escape: Closes the palette when closeOnEscape is true and restores focus.
keyboard.Shift+Tab: Cycles backward within a modal palette.
